errors.text_span: Visually, the segments are arranged in descending order of size, progressing counter-clockwise starting from the top vertical axis.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The slice at the top vertical axis is 'Very easy' (4.7%), which is the smallest slice. Progressing counter-clockwise from there does not yield a descending order of sizes (the sequence is 4.7%, 51.8%, 25.7%, etc.). The slices are arranged in descending order starting from the 'Medium' slice and moving counter-clockwise.
